name: Kids Path
description: Fun and simple AI learning for young explorers (ages 8-14)

lessons.title: Welcome, Young AI Trainer! 🌟
lessons.content: Hey there! 👋 Did you know that AI is like having a super smart robot friend? But here's the secret: you need to give it REALLY good instructions, or it might get confused! This game will teach you how to be an awesome AI trainer!
keyPoints: AI needs clear instructions, just like following a recipe
It's okay to try again if it doesn't work the first time!

lessons.title: Mission 1: Create Your Dream Pet! 🐾
lessons.scenario: Imagine you could design any pet you want - real or imaginary! Maybe a purple cat? A tiny elephant? A dragon that loves pizza?
lessons.task: Tell the AI about your dream pet! Describe what it looks like, what it likes to do, and its special powers.
lessons.evaluationCriteria: describing appearance, personality, and special abilities
hints: How big is it? (tiny like a mouse? huge like a car?)
What does it like to eat?
What's its special power or trick?

lessons.title: The Magic of Details ✨
lessons.content: Here's a cool trick: The more details you give, the better the AI understands! It's like the difference between saying 'draw a house' and 'draw a yellow house with a red door, two windows, and a garden full of sunflowers.'

examples.specific: Make a peanut butter and jelly sandwich with grape jelly on white bread, cut diagonally

lessons.title: Mission 2: Write a Birthday Party Plan! 🎉
lessons.scenario: Your best friend's birthday is coming up! You want to throw them the COOLEST party ever!
lessons.task: Ask AI to help plan the party! Tell it about your friend (what they like), what kind of party you want, and all the fun stuff you want to include.
lessons.evaluationCriteria: including friend's interests, party theme, activities, food, decorations
hints: What does your friend love? (dinosaurs? unicorns? video games?)

lessons.title: Mission 3: Invent a New Game! 🎲
lessons.scenario: You're going to invent a brand new game that no one has ever played before!
lessons.task: Describe your game to AI so clearly that someone else could play it just by reading your description.
lessons.evaluationCriteria: explaining how to play, what you need, how to win, rules
hints: What's the name of your game?
What do you need to play? (cards? dice? chalk?)
How do you play? (explain step by step)

lessons.title: Mission 4: Create a Superhero! 🦸
lessons.scenario: Time to create your own superhero! Give them awesome powers, a cool costume, and a secret identity!
lessons.task: Describe your superhero in so much detail that AI could draw them or write a story about them!
lessons.evaluationCriteria: superhero powers, costume design, secret identity, personality, catchphrase
hints: Describe their costume (colors, mask, cape, symbol)

lessons.title: Mission 5: Write a Silly Story! 📖
lessons.scenario: Create the silliest story ever! It should have funny characters, a weird problem, and a surprising ending!
lessons.task: Give AI instructions to write your silly story. Include all the important details!
lessons.evaluationCriteria: story characters, setting, problem, solution, funny elements
hints: Should it rhyme or be a regular story?

lessons.title: MEGA MISSION: Design Your Dream Treehouse! 🏡
lessons.scenario: You get to design the most AMAZING treehouse in the world! It can have anything you want - secret rooms, slides, rope bridges, you name it!
lessons.task: Describe your dream treehouse in SUPER detail so AI can understand your amazing vision!
lessons.evaluationCriteria: structure details, special features, rooms, access methods, decorations, secret elements
hints: What tree is it in? How high up?
How do you get up? (ladder? stairs? rope? elevator?)
Any secret passages or hidden areas?
What makes it special and different?
